name: You Look Upon the Tarrasque
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Run and Hide — Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control this turn.
• Gather Your Courage — Target creature gets +5/+5 and gains indestructible until end of turn. All creatures your opponents control able to block that creature this turn do so.
blocked_sentences: • Run and Hide — Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control this turn

needs.what: a combat-only option on the resolving prevention ops: `combat_only: true` on `prevent_damage` (the player's DamageShield) and on `prevent_damage_permanent` (or a selector-scoped variant covering 'creatures you control' for the turn), so a spell can say 'Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control this turn' while noncombat damage still gets through
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` op (player, duration) and `prevent_damage_permanent` op (objects, dealt, duration) both prevent ALL damage, combat and noncombat, which is a strictly better card; the new `combat_only` flag exists only on the `prevent_damage` STATIC, which lives on a permanent and has no 'this turn' clock and cannot be installed by an instant
